summary.headline: Canara Robeco AMC Q2 FY27 revenue from operations rose 17% YoY to INR 121.6 crores and PAT rose 21% to INR 59.2 crores.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations grew 17% YoY to INR 121.6 crores and PAT grew 21% to INR 59.2 crores, with H1 PAT up 23% to INR 134.8 crores. Closing AUM was INR 1.17 lakh crores, with September quarterly average AUM up 4% YoY, while management described the quarter as challenged by a roughly 6% Nifty fall in September. The company declared an interim dividend of INR 2 per share. Management did not disclose net flows, and analysts questioned SIP book and folio trends, which management attributed to ELSS tax-law changes, vintage SIP maturities, and market-driven closures.

segments.name: Equity
segments.commentary: Equity is about 91% of AUM; SIP AUM is about INR 41,000 crores, roughly 34% of AUM or more than one-third of equity AUM. Equity yield was around 40 bps in Q2.

segments.name: Fixed income / debt
segments.commentary: Fixed income yield was around 28 bps in Q2. Management said the INR 600 crores debt book is linked to skin-in-the-game (about INR 110 crores), which is marked to market and shows up in other income.

segments.name: Liquid and overnight
segments.commentary: Yield around 2 bps in Q2. No AUM figure was disclosed for this category.

qa_highlights.question: Execution priorities for next 6-12 months and key risks?
qa_highlights.answer: Focus on new products and evaluating new lines of business (passives, SIF, AIF, GIFT City), with one chosen to go ahead; renewed SIP focus with channel partners and the Goal SIP initiative.

qa_highlights.question: Update on product launch pipeline (passive product mentioned last call)?
qa_highlights.answer: At least a couple of launches before end-March 2027, subject to regulatory approvals; one or two of passives, SIF, AIF or GIFT City over 6-12 months.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the SIP book shrinking while industry SIP book rises; yield outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Yields to stay in the 35-40 bps comfort range. SIP AUM value is up to about INR 41,000 crores (34% of AUM); drivers are the Tax Saver (ELSS) law change, SIP maturities and volatility-driven closures.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company disclose net inflows, and are they negative?
qa_highlights.answer: Atit Turakhiya said the company follows industry disclosure standards and is not disclosing net flows at this time.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the company's SIP monthly contribution soft, and how much of SIP is ELSS?
qa_highlights.answer: Gaurav Goyal cited ELSS decline and vintage SIP maturities; the ELSS share of SIP was not disclosed. He highlighted flagship fund AUM above INR 25,000 crores, four funds above INR 10,000 crores, and multi-cap and mid-cap strategies above INR 5,000 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Segment-wise yields and reason for 4-5 bps expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: Overall yield 37-38 bps for the quarter; equity around 40 bps, fixed income around 28 bps, liquid and overnight around 2 bps. No explicit reason for the expansion was given.

qa_highlights.question: Is the other income (INR 29 crores last quarter) linked to the INR 600 crores debt book?
qa_highlights.answer: Rajnish Narula said it reflects skin-in-the-game of about INR 110 crores, marked to market each quarter, with about 90% in equity; other income will vary quarter to quarter.

guidance_outlook: Management is targeting at least a couple of new product launches before end-March 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.
Management is evaluating new lines of business (passives, SIF, AIF, GIFT City) and expects to launch one or two over the next 6 to 12 months.
A fund launch, which will be an equity fund, is planned before end-March 2027.
Management is comfortable with yields in the 35-40 bps range and said it would rather focus on growth and volumes than yield.
Management said it is working with selected partners to increase SIP market share, including Canara Bank, MFDs, NDs and digital partners, and is launching Goal SIP.
capex_capacity: No capex or capacity figures were discussed on the call.
Distribution network: over 57,186 empanelled partners and 29 branches; B-30 AUM INR 28,944 crores (23.6% of total AUM).
Investor folios 50.1 lakh; 19.6 lakh active SIP accounts; September SIP contribution INR 676 crores.
demand_pricing: Nifty 50 fell about 6% in September 2026 and closed nearly 14% below its 52-week high; the company said markets were challenged, and management said flows are concentrated in a few product categories (65% of industry flows in H1 in three categories, per Gaurav Goyal).
Monthly SIP contributions across the industry crossed INR 32,000 crores, with SIP accounts above 10 crores.
Company AUM growth: September 2026 quarterly average AUM up 4% YoY; individual investors are over 86% of AUM.
Market share in equity is stable at about 2%, per management.
Management did not disclose net flows, citing industry-consistent disclosure standards. Analysts' estimates of negative or flat net flows were not confirmed or refuted.
SIP book: management said value of SIP AUM is up while SIP accounts and folios declined, attributing this to ELSS tax-law changes, vintage SIP maturities and market-driven closures.
risks_watch: SIP book and folio decline: SIP accounts and folios fell, with ELSS tax-law changes and vintage SIP maturities cited; management did not disclose SIP attrition.

Yield and distributor economics: management is comfortable in the 35-40 bps range and sees no need to change distributor structures, but revenue yield was flat QoQ, and the TER-to-BR pass-through benefit from last quarter appears to be fading.

Investment performance: some funds are in lower quartiles; management expects recovery but gave no timeline. Overlap regulation for equity schemes was flagged as a possible cause of inflow cyclicality.
Market volatility and net flows: net flows are not disclosed, and an analyst estimate suggested flat equity inflows in Q2.
Regulatory approval dependence: launch timing for new products and lines of business depends on approvals.
key_quotes: In my view, this resilience of domestic flows is one of the most important developments shaping the Indian mutual fund industry today.
So income from operations is what shows you the steady -state growth in the business itself.
We would rather focus on growth and additional volumes than focus solely on yields.
We are probably, given our size, one of the smallest.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term structural drivers and the earnings trajectory, but guarded on flows, SIP trends and net inflow disclosure, and deferred several questions to other teams or to the lack of public data.

growth.why: No numeric revenue guidance; management held a 35-40 bps yield range and targets at least a couple of product launches before end-March 2027 subject to approvals, with no capacity additions or capex discussed and SIP accounts and folios declining.
